description.en: ✨ All your agents and workspaces in one place, on every device you own. Track tasks on a board, accessible from desktop, mobile, browser, or API. Self-hosted.
description.zh: 一个自托管的AI代理和工作区管理平台，支持任务板和多设备访问。

audience.zh: 需要统一管理多个AI代理和项目的开发者和团队
audience.en: Developers and teams who need to manage multiple AI agents and projects in one place

usecases.zh: 在自托管环境中集中管理AI代理、任务板和跨设备访问
usecases.en: Centralize AI agent management, task boards, and cross-device access in a self-hosted environment
